title: Uniform current injection in a square plate: 2D Poisson series and mesh convergence (electric currents, analytic)
description:
A square conducting plate (side a, conductivity sigma) with a uniform volumetric current_source s on every cell and all four faces grounded (voltage 0): -div(sigma grad V) = s, a genuinely 2D problem (the torsion problem of a square bar). The sweep refines the mesh, N = a / dx in {25, 51, 101, 201} (odd, so the plate centre is a cell centre).
Analytic: V = (s / (2 sigma)) [x (a - x) - (8 a^2 / pi^3) sum_{n odd} sin(n pi x / a) cosh(n pi (y - a/2) / a) / (n^3 cosh(n pi / 2))] (n = 1..7 kept: the rest is < 1e-4 of V_max on the curves below, which stay away from the corners where the series converges slowly); V_centre = 0.073671 s a^2 / sigma; integral V dA = 0.035144 s a^4 / sigma (series in tanh(n pi / 2) / n^5 with (31/32) zeta(5)).
Derived values tab: I_ground (current of the grounded faces = -s a^2 per m of depth, charge conservation: exact), V_centre (probe at the plate centre) and P_joule (integral of q_joule = s integral V dA, since V = 0 on the faces). Second order in dx: expect ~1.5e-3 (V_centre) and ~4e-3 (P_joule) at N = 25, about 4x smaller per refinement (~3e-5 / ~1e-4 at N = 201); the tolerance holds at every sweep value.
Sweep tab: V_centre vs N with the dashed analytic value (2nd-order approach).
Line profile tab (N = 201): V_mid_line (along y = a/2) and V_diagonal (the diagonal from a/8 to 7a/8), ~1e-4 of V_max.

parameters.name: s_inject
parameters.description: injected current per volume in A/m^3

parameters.name: N_cells
parameters.description: cells per side (swept; odd so the centre is a cell centre)

parameters.name: V_half
parameters.description: potential scale s / (2 sigma) in V/m^2

parameters.name: V_centre_ref
parameters.description: analytic centre potential (0.073671 s a^2 / sigma) in V

parameters.name: tanh_sum
parameters.description: sum over odd n of tanh(n pi / 2) / n^5: (31/32) zeta(5) minus the first deficits

parameters.name: P_ref
parameters.description: analytic Joule power s integral V dA in W per m of depth (0.035144 s^2 a^4 / sigma)

analytic_curves.name: V_mid_line
analytic_curves.expression: V_half*(x*(a_plate - x) - 8*a_plate**2/pi**3*(sin(pi*x/a_plate)*cosh(pi*(y - a_plate/2)/a_plate)/cosh(pi/2) + sin(3*pi*x/a_plate)*cosh(3*pi*(y - a_plate/2)/a_plate)/(27*cosh(3*pi/2)) + sin(5*pi*x/a_plate)*cosh(5*pi*(y - a_plate/2)/a_plate)/(125*cosh(5*pi/2)) + sin(7*pi*x/a_plate)*cosh(7*pi*(y - a_plate/2)/a_plate)/(343*cosh(7*pi/2))))
